papers.title: Learning One Representation to Optimize All Rewards
papers.selection_reason: 与源论文同属无监督/零样本强化学习，均先学习可复用的奖励或动力学表示，再针对事后指定的奖励直接产生策略。
papers.planned_scope: 选择 Continuous Maze 或 FetchReach，完成 FB 表示训练、零样本奖励适配和至少一个 goal-oriented baseline；3 个随机种子。
primary_artifacts: Success rate curves for goal-reaching tasks
Trajectories for complex rewards (forbidden states, multiple goals)

compute.notes: 论文未报告 GPU 型号、数量或总时长；官方实现为 PyTorch RL，任务包括 maze、FetchReach 和 Ms. Pacman。 模型显存需求很小，单卡无压力；主要耗时在环境交互而非 GPU。 Non-GPU risks: 环境采样时间; 完整多环境 sweep 的总时长未知

papers.title: Neural Text Generation with Unlikelihood Training
papers.selection_reason: 同样通过显式偏好/负反馈目标抑制不期望的语言模型行为，具有清晰损失函数、毒性/生成实验和可复现代码。
papers.planned_scope: 使用 GPT-2 medium + WikiText-103，复现 MLE 与 token/sequence unlikelihood 的 perplexity 和 repetition 对比；用梯度累积保持有效 batch。
primary_artifacts: Reduction in sequence-level repetition (seq-rep-4) on Wikitext-103

compute.notes: 固定序列长度 1536；原论文使用 8 张未注明型号的 GPU，最多训练 150k updates。 模型和优化器可放入 120GB；单卡可以运行，但不保证达到原 8 卡 wall-clock。 Non-GPU risks: 150k updates 可能耗时较长; 原论文人工评价不纳入 task

papers.title: Transferring GANs: generating images from limited data
papers.selection_reason: 两者核心问题都是小数据生成模型的迁移学习；模型家族不同，但训练设定、数据缺口与迁移评测最接近。
papers.planned_scope: 在一个低分辨率目标域上比较预训练 GAN 迁移与从头训练，报告 FID/IW 及收敛曲线。
primary_artifacts: Analysis of dataset size and source domain effects

compute.notes: 论文只说明获得 NVIDIA GPU 支持，未报告型号/数量/时长；实验包含 25k iterations 的迁移训练。 老一代 GAN 规模远低于 120GB 显存限制；单卡资源足够。 Non-GPU risks: 旧版 TensorFlow/PyTorch 依赖兼容性; 预训练权重下载

papers.title: Tent: Fully Test-Time Adaptation by Entropy Minimization
papers.selection_reason: 直接的 test-time adaptation 方法和实验 baseline；只依赖测试流和已训练模型，任务边界清楚，适合作为 PaperBench 复现目标。
papers.planned_scope: Reproduce fully test-time entropy minimization on CIFAR-10-C and CIFAR-100-C, including source, normalization-statistics adaptation, and Tent comparisons plus the normalization-parameter ablation.

compute.notes: Adaptation is inference-time and updates only normalization affine parameters; no source retraining is required for the scoped task.

papers.title: Graphically Structured Diffusion Models
papers.selection_reason: 同样用结构化注意力/图结构约束扩散模型处理多变量联合分布，是 Simformer 在模型形式上最接近的相关工作。
papers.planned_scope: 选择 BCMF 或 Sudoku，比较 structured attention、unstructured transformer 和关键 ablation。
primary_artifacts: Trained GSDM models for BCMF, Sudoku, sorting, and Boolean tasks
Ablation studies showing benefits of structured attention and intermediate variables

compute.notes: 论文未报告 GPU 型号、数量和训练时长；任务是 BCMF、Sudoku、sorting 和 Boolean synthetic problems。 单任务模型可放入一张 H200；完整四任务、多尺寸 sweep 的时长未知。 Non-GPU risks: 论文未给 compute statement; 完整 sweep 可能较长

papers.title: Sequential Neural Likelihood: Fast Likelihood-free Inference with Autoregressive Flows
papers.selection_reason: 同属 sequential simulation-based inference，通过逐轮聚焦模拟预算逼近后验；方法、benchmark 和评测协议高度相似。
papers.planned_scope: Implement sequential neural likelihood with an autoregressive density estimator on the toy complex-posterior problem and one scientific simulator, comparing posterior quality against simulation budget.
primary_artifacts: Toy posterior visualization or quantitative distance

compute.notes: The neural density estimator is small; simulator wall time, not GPU memory, is the primary constraint.

papers.title: Adversarial Training for Free!
papers.selection_reason: 同属对抗微调与鲁棒表示学习，并强调降低 adversarial training 成本；比通用 VLM 论文更像可独立复现的算法任务。
papers.planned_scope: 优先复现 CIFAR-10 的 free adversarial training 与 PGD baseline；若要求 ImageNet，使用单卡、梯度累积并单独设长时任务。
primary_artifacts: Robust model trained on ImageNet with 40% accuracy against PGD attacks
Robust models on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with comparable robustness to PGD training

compute.notes: ImageNet 主实验使用 4×P100，约 2 天；ResNet-101/152 分别约为 ResNet-50 时长的 1.7×/2.4×。 120GB 可容纳模型和 batch；算法不依赖跨卡通信，但单卡 ImageNet wall-clock 需实测，不能直接承诺 2 天内。 Non-GPU risks: ImageNet 数据与存储; 攻击评测耗时; 原始 launcher 的多卡参数需改为单卡

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Example Forgetting during Deep Neural Network Learning
papers.selection_reason: 直接研究样本级 forgetting event，并从训练轨迹预测哪些样本会被遗忘；与源论文的样本级遗忘预测目标最一致。
papers.planned_scope: Record forgetting events during CIFAR-10 training, test stability across seeds or architectures, and reproduce the effect of removing unforgettable examples on test accuracy.

compute.notes: Small image models and CIFAR-10 fit comfortably; multiple seeds can be run serially.

papers.title: When and why PINNs fail to train: A neural tangent kernel perspective
papers.selection_reason: 同样解释 PINN 训练失败及不同损失项的优化失衡，只是分析工具从 loss landscape 换为 NTK；实验链条几乎可复用。
papers.planned_scope: Reproduce standard and NTK-guided adaptive-loss PINNs on the 1D Poisson and wave problems, including relative L2 error, loss convergence, and at least one NTK spectrum or eigenvalue-dynamics result.

compute.notes: Synthetic collocation data and small fully connected networks make the scoped experiments inexpensive.

papers.title: GeDi: Generative Discriminator Guided Sequence Generation
papers.selection_reason: 同为无需重训主语言模型的生成时引导方法，通过正负条件分数控制主题和属性，形式上最接近 classifier-free guidance。
papers.planned_scope: Train one topic or sentiment GeDi and use it to guide GPT-2 generation, comparing unguided generation, GeDi, and PPLM with automatic attribute accuracy, perplexity, and generation speed; human evaluation is excluded.

compute.notes: The paper reports single-GPU training in under one day; one automatic-evaluation control setting is suitable for an H200 task.

papers.title: StateMask: Explaining Deep Reinforcement Learning through State Masking
papers.selection_reason: 同属强化学习解释生成，并以解释质量及策略行为改进做定量评测；它还是 RICE 的实验 baseline，最符合新的一对一条件。
papers.planned_scope: 选择 Pong 或 Connect 4，复现 StateMask 与 1–2 个 explainer 的 explanation score 和 masked-policy value difference；3–5 seeds。

datasets.name: Pong or Connect Four interaction trajectories

compute.notes: 论文未明确报告 GPU 型号；覆盖 Pong、Connect 4、StarCraft II 等 10 个任务，部分实验包含 500 runs。 解释模型本身较小，单卡足够；不应把完整 StarCraft II 和 500-run sweep 设为必做。 Non-GPU risks: 环境/agent checkpoint 获取; 完整 500 runs 的环境时间

papers.title: AutoVP: An Automated Visual Prompting Framework and Benchmark
papers.selection_reason: 同属视觉重编程/视觉 prompting，均冻结预训练模型并学习输入变换；AutoVP 的自动 prompt 搜索与 sample-specific mask 最接近。
papers.planned_scope: Jointly optimize input scaling, a visual prompt, and label mapping on two or three public image-classification datasets, comparing against fixed visual prompting and a linear probe.

compute.notes: The paper reports a single RTX 3090 setup; the scoped dataset subset fits comfortably on one H200.

papers.title: AdaLoRA: Adaptive Budget Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.selection_reason: 与 APT 一样根据参数重要性动态分配有限微调预算；虽然采用低秩适配而非剪枝，但自适应预算设定和评测最接近且官方仓库当前可达。
papers.planned_scope: Compare LoRA and AdaLoRA under matched trainable-parameter budgets using a base-sized encoder on two or three GLUE tasks, and analyze the learned rank allocation.

compute.notes: Base-sized encoders and parameter-efficient fine-tuning fit on one H200; tasks should be run serially.

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.selection_reason: PPO 是 SAPG 的直接策略梯度 baseline；相较依赖大规模 actor-learner 集群的 IMPALA，PPO 的官方实现可在单机单卡上保留完整算法和主要控制任务评测。
papers.planned_scope: 选择 2 个 MuJoCo/Procgen 或 1 个 Atari 环境，复现 PPO-Clip 对 TRPO/A2C 的 sample efficiency；3 seeds。

compute.notes: 原论文未给统一 GPU 数；官方 ppo2 支持 GPU，并通过并行环境采样。典型复现为 MuJoCo 1–3M steps 或 Atari 10M+ steps。 策略网络很小，单卡显存无压力；CPU 环境吞吐是主要瓶颈。 Non-GPU risks: MuJoCo 版本和许可证兼容; 环境采样的 CPU 核数

papers.title: Agreement-on-the-Line: Predicting the Performance of Neural Networks under Distribution Shift
papers.selection_reason: 源论文在命名、问题设定和线性预测框架上直接延续该工作；都是用 ID 统计量预测 OOD 性能，是 20 组中最强的一一对应。
papers.planned_scope: Using predictions from 10 to 20 public CIFAR-10 models, reproduce agreement-on-the-line and ALine-D on CIFAR-10.1, CIFAR-10.2, and CINIC-10, reporting OOD-accuracy prediction MAE and goodness of fit.

compute.notes: Inference over a bounded public model collection is feasible; reproducing every model family and shift in the paper is intentionally deferred.

papers.title: Improving and generalizing flow-based generative models with minibatch optimal transport
papers.selection_reason: 同样学习连接源分布和目标分布的连续概率路径，并使用 coupling 改善训练；方法和生成评测均高度相似。
papers.planned_scope: 先复现 2D/单细胞 OT 路径结果，再在 CIFAR-10 上训练 I-CFM 与 OT-CFM 的相同小型 U-Net，报告有限 checkpoint 的 FID。

compute.notes: toy neural-OT 表中 CFM/RF 可在单 CPU core 训练；CIFAR-10 结果训练到 400k steps，但论文未报告该实验 GPU 型号/数量。 显存预计可满足单卡训练；400k-step CIFAR wall-clock 未报告，必须先做 1k-step benchmark 再定完整预算。 Non-GPU risks: FID 50k sampling 时间; 原论文 CIFAR compute 不透明

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.selection_reason: 同样把黑盒 LLM 的输出、反馈和迭代修正组合成外部适配流程，不需要更新底层模型权重，且任务与指标清晰。
papers.planned_scope: 禁止闭源 API，使用 StarChat-beta 或同规模公开模型，在 HumanEval 子集上比较 base、self-reflection 和 episodic memory。
primary_artifacts: Reflexion framework with episodic memory buffer
Ablation studies on feedback signals and memory

compute.notes: 论文主结果大量使用 GPT-3/3.5/4 API；同时报告 StarChat-beta 在 HumanEval 上的结果，但未给本地 GPU 型号。 约 15B 级开源模型的推理可放入 120GB；不能声称复现 GPT-4 的 91% pass@1 headline。 Non-GPU risks: 官方仓库默认 API 路径需要改成本地推理; 代码执行沙箱安全

papers.title: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming
papers.selection_reason: 同为以模型性能为目标的 coreset selection，并将选择过程写成优化问题；数据、训练、选择和结果链条完整。
papers.planned_scope: Implement bilevel coreset selection for continual learning on SplitMNIST and SplitCIFAR-10, compare with uniform or reservoir selection, and report accuracy, forgetting, and selection cost.

compute.notes: The paper reports single-GPU experiments on a GTX 1080 Ti; the selected domains are much smaller than H200 memory.

papers.title: Variational Inference with Gaussian Score Matching
papers.selection_reason: 这是 BaM 的直接前作和主要 baseline，同样是 Gaussian black-box VI、score matching 与闭式参数更新，复现实验可直接对齐。
papers.planned_scope: Implement Gaussian score-matching variational inference and compare its convergence and gradient-evaluation efficiency with black-box variational inference on a Gaussian target and one hierarchical posterior.

compute.notes: The selected low-dimensional inference experiments are light enough to run on CPU; the H200 is more than sufficient.

papers.title: DisCoRL: Continual Reinforcement Learning via Policy Distillation
papers.selection_reason: 直接处理 continual RL 中的灾难性遗忘，并用策略蒸馏保存旧任务能力；可将复现范围限制在论文的模拟导航实验。
papers.planned_scope: 只复现 simulation：顺序学习三个导航任务、policy distillation 和 forgetting/retention 曲线；删除真实机器人部分。
primary_artifacts: Performance box plots of teacher and student policies in simulation and real-life.
Comparison of distillation losses and data sampling strategies.

compute.notes: 论文未报告 GPU；包含三个模拟 2D 导航任务和真实三轮全向机器人 transfer。 模拟策略和表示模型很小，单卡足够；完整真实机器人结果不满足纯计算环境约束。 Non-GPU risks: 旧机器人模拟环境依赖; 真实机器人实验必须明确排除
